item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, copy, work\\n\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','meta':{'x':1,'y':2}}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'meta':{'y':2,'x':1},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['gone','still-gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone']}),\\n ({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'z':1},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'z':2}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n]\\nfor request, policy, expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy))\\n got=work.evaluate(request,policy)\\n assert got==expected,(got,expected)\\n assert request==before[0] and policy==before[1]\\n assert set(got)=={'needs_review','changed'}\\nprint('custom checks passed', len(cases))\\n\"]}"}
